declarations.docstring: Extends the specified formula on pure tensors in a direct-sum summand to every tensor in that summand.
Views an element of the subalgebra as a linear endomorphism over its centralizer.
The centralizer-linear map associated to an element acts by that element.
An element of the subalgebra commutes with every element of its centralizer.
The submodule over the centralizer associated to an element of the subalgebra.
Under the stated decomposition and component hypotheses, the associated centralizer submodule is simple.
Characterizes membership in the associated centralizer submodule by membership in the range of the element.
A rank-one idempotent has a nonzero fixed vector that generates its range.
If a linear map has range spanned by a vector, its action on every tensor is a pure tensor with that first factor.
